law_name: Law on Copyright and Related Rights (Official Gazette of Montenegro 37/2011, as amended to 100/2024)
term_of_protection: Author's life + 70 years (anonymous and collective works: 70 years from publication)
moral_rights: Moral rights not transferable by contract
orphan_works: Orphan works provisions modelled on Directive 2012/28/EU (2016 amendment; Art. 20, 69e-69f)
digital_protection: Technological measures protected under art. 186; circumvention of effective TPMs treated as infringement (2016 amendment); RMI article not confirmed (unconfirmed)
fair_use_exceptions: Closed list of free uses incl. TDM (2024), parody/pastiche, accessible-format copies
enforcement_body: Intellectual Property Office of Montenegro; Ministry of Economic Development

changes.from: WCT party: anti-circumvention protection required by WCT art. 11 (national rule not checked)
